items.question: Why should the discerning seeker look further after this shown teaching?
premises: This has been shown in the supreme procedure by vaitatya.
Therefore the discerning one desiring expansion should look further.
items.inference: The verse directs further examination after the shown exposition.
uncertainties: vaitatya may name a specific method or principle.
items.plain_english: This has been shown in the supreme procedure by vaitatya; therefore the discerning one who desires expansion should look further.

items.question: What has been properly accomplished regarding the form of tattva?
premises: Thus the form of tattva has been properly illuminated.
items.inference: The verse closes the exposition of tattva's form.
uncertainties: tattvasya may refer to tattva generally or a specific tattva.
items.plain_english: Thus the form of tattva has been properly illuminated.
